facts.summary: On-target neutropenia dose-limiting toxicities and weak responses in first cohort · Phase 1/2 · CFT7455 in multiple myeloma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: On-Target Dose Limiting Toxicity Observed; Modeling Suggests Differentiated Activity and PK Profile Provides Pathway to Increase Therapeutic Index with Alternative Dosing Schedule
evidence.safety: There were no serious adverse events reported and no adverse events resulted in death or treatment discontinuation.
evidence.program_discontinued: Patients are enrolling in Cohort B1, exploring CFT7455 as a monotherapy for RRMM, and Cohort C, exploring CFT7455 as a monotherapy for NHL.
